description: This source file defines functions related to engine trigger event decoding and configuration, including trigger shape initialization, event scheduling for different engine configurations, and utility functions for trigger processing within an engine management system.

methods.name: getEngineCycle
methods.description: Returns engine cycle duration based on operation mode (two-stroke or four-stroke).

methods.name: addSkippedToothTriggerEvents
methods.description: Schedules trigger events for teeth on a trigger wheel, considering skipped teeth.

methods.name: initializeSkippedToothTriggerShapeExt
methods.description: Initializes a trigger shape with skipped teeth pattern and synchronization settings.

methods.name: configureOnePlusOne
methods.description: Configures trigger events for a specific engine sequence with primary and secondary triggers.

methods.name: configureOnePlus60_2
methods.description: Configures trigger events for a 60-teeth wheel with skipped teeth and specific timing.

methods.name: configure3_1_cam
methods.description: Configures a trigger shape for a 3/1 cam engine setup, setting events for multiple crank rotations.
